summary: Versatile Software Engineer with eight years of professional experience spanning full-stack development and cloud-native architecture. Strong expertise in Node.js/Express and API development, with a proven record of modernizing systems using Docker and microservices. Experienced in designing and operating SQL and NoSQL data layers, and delivering production workloads on AWS and GCP. Background also includes successful Salesforce integrations within customer-facing platforms.

careers.title: Software Engineer
descriptions: Developed and maintained Node.js / Express REST APIs supporting an AI-powered scheduling assistant SaaS product.
Designed and optimized SQL data models using PostgreSQL, ensuring reliability and performance of core application workflows.
Containerized backend services using Docker, enabling a microservices-based architecture and consistent deployment across environments.
Deployed and operated backend services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), leveraging Cloud Run, Firebase, and Pub/Sub for event-driven processing.
Collaborated as a full-stack engineer, connecting Node.js APIs with a React-based web portal to deliver personalized user experiences.

careers.title: Alexa Skills Developer
descriptions: Built production-grade Node.js APIs using the Alexa SDK to support a skill with over one million active users.
Implemented NoSQL data storage using DynamoDB (AWS) to persist user preferences and personalized settings.
Developed API-driven AWS Lambda functions to update station catalogs through internal services on a scheduled basis.
Collaborated with AWS engineers to design, test, and iterate on new API features for beta Alexa Skill releases.

careers.title: Agile Software Engineer
descriptions: Developed Node.js / Express REST APIs consumed by multiple client platforms and internal teams.
Designed and queried SQL databases (PostgreSQL) to support web and IoT applications.
Contributed to authentication and authorization API development using AWS Cognito.
Built and maintained serverless APIs on AWS using Lambda and DynamoDB (NoSQL).
Practiced Test-Driven Development (TDD) across backend API services and frontend components

careers.title: Front-End Developer
descriptions: Integrated front-end applications with backend API services for a financial web platform.
Collaborated on a Ruby on Rails application backed by SQL database (PostgreSQL).
Integrated Salesforce and Pardot APIs to streamline lead tracking, marketing automation, and sales handoff.

careers.title: Web Application Developer
descriptions: Led front-end development efforts, creating over 50 pages using Angular, JSP, and SASS.
Supported backend development using SQL databases (MySQL) and Java-based APIs.
Worked closely with backend teams to integrate frontend features with server-side APIs.
Designed for compatibility with various devices and browsers.
